landing.faq.title: FAQ
landing.faq.a1: A platform for CTF competitions and cybersecurity practice: flag-checked challenges, isolated labs and a live scoreboard in one place. Created at Kharkiv National University of Radio Electronics (KhNURE), in the V. V. Popovskyi ICE Department.
landing.faq.a2: For participants — university students, school students who compete in olympiads, and teams from other institutions — and for organizers who run competitions and olympiads.
landing.faq.q3: Can I play solo, or only in a team?
landing.faq.a3: Both. The organizer picks an individual or a team format; in a team event you create a team or join one with a code.
landing.faq.q4: What kinds of challenges are there?
landing.faq.a4: Web, cryptography, binary exploitation, reverse engineering, forensics. Simple challenges are verified with a flag; more complex ones deploy their own infrastructure.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: This Policy explains what personal data the Cyber ICE Box platform (the "Platform") processes, why and for how long, who we share it with and what rights you have. It follows the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection".
legal.privacy.s1.heading: Who processes your data
legal.privacy.s1.items.1: The controller is the Cyber ICE Box project team ("we"), an independent group of developers not registered as a legal entity. The project is supported by the V. V. Popovskyi Department of Infocommunication Engineering of Kharkiv National University of Radio Electronics (KhNURE); the University is not a controller of your data and does not operate the Platform.
legal.privacy.s1.items.2: The organizer of an event is responsible for the content of its registration forms.
legal.privacy.s2.heading: Data we process
legal.privacy.s2.items.1: Account: first and last name, email address, profile picture, password in protected form, and your Google identifier (if you sign in with Google).
legal.privacy.s2.items.2: Event participation: teams, invitations, answers, points, leaderboards and registration form answers.
legal.privacy.s2.items.3: Technical data: IP address and browser data, and logs of sign-ins, lab and VPN access, and email delivery.
legal.privacy.s2.after: Please do not include special categories of data (such as health or beliefs) in forms or answers.
legal.privacy.s3.heading: Purposes and legal bases
legal.privacy.s3.items.1: Providing the Platform (account, event participation, leaderboards, lab access, service emails) — performance of the Terms of Use.
legal.privacy.s3.items.2: Security and abuse prevention, including protecting forms against bots and logging — our legitimate interest.
legal.privacy.s3.items.4: Compliance with the law — legal obligation.
legal.privacy.s3.after: We do not sell personal data or use it for advertising.
legal.privacy.s4.heading: Who we share data with
legal.privacy.s4.body: We share data only to the extent needed for the purpose concerned:
legal.privacy.s4.items.3: Bot protection and third-party sign-in services (including sign-in with Google).
legal.privacy.s4.items.4: Analytics services — only with your consent.
legal.privacy.s4.items.5: Network protection and content delivery services.
legal.privacy.s4.items.6: Event organizers — data about the participants of their event.
legal.privacy.s4.items.7: Other participants — your name or team name and your results on leaderboards.
legal.privacy.s4.items.8: Public authorities — only where required by law.
legal.privacy.s5.heading: International transfers
legal.privacy.s5.body: Some providers may process data outside Ukraine; in that case we rely on their contractual data protection safeguards.
legal.privacy.s6.heading: Retention
legal.privacy.s6.items.1: Account — while it is active. An unfinished registration (an invitation or a self sign-up that was never confirmed) is deleted 30 days after it was created or after the last invitation was sent, whichever is later. After a deletion request — no longer than 30 days; accounts inactive for over 3 years are deleted after a warning.
legal.privacy.s6.items.2: Sign-in, lab and VPN access logs — up to 90 days; email delivery logs — up to 180 days; backups — up to 30 days.
legal.privacy.s6.items.3: Registration form answers and the event activity log (task opens, file downloads, rejected attempts, team changes, stand and VPN status) — until the event ends plus 1 year; the history of service events (registrations, invitations) — 1 year, and it is anonymized when the account is deleted.
legal.privacy.s6.items.4: Competition results — kept as part of the event history; they are anonymized when the account is deleted.
legal.privacy.s6.items.5: Cookies — see the [Cookie Policy](/cookies); analytics data — 14 months.
legal.privacy.s7.heading: Your rights
legal.privacy.s7.items.2: You can have inaccurate data corrected.
legal.privacy.s7.items.3: You can request erasure of your data.
legal.privacy.s7.items.4: You can request restriction of processing.
legal.privacy.s7.items.6: You can receive your data in a machine-readable format.
legal.privacy.s7.items.7: You can withdraw consent at any time via "Cookie settings".
legal.privacy.s7.items.8: You can lodge a complaint with the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights.
legal.privacy.s7.after: To exercise your rights, contact us at the address given at the end of this document. We respond within 30 days.
legal.privacy.s8.heading: Children
legal.privacy.s8.body: Persons under 14 may use the Platform only with the consent of a parent or other legal guardian; for events for minors, the organizer obtains this consent. If a child's data was received without consent, let us know and we will delete it.
legal.privacy.s9.heading: Security
legal.privacy.s9.body: We encrypt data in transit, store passwords securely, restrict access to data to authorised team members, isolate lab environments and update the Platform regularly. We will notify you of any security breach that puts your rights at risk.
legal.privacy.s10.heading: Changes to this Policy
legal.privacy.s10.items.1: We announce material changes by email to all account holders and on the Platform at least 14 days before they take effect.
legal.privacy.s10.items.2: Minor edits (wording or typo fixes that do not change the meaning) only update the "Last updated" date.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
legal.terms.intro: These Terms of Use (the "Terms") govern access to and use of the Cyber ICE Box platform (the "Platform"), a cybersecurity training environment for lab work and CTF competitions.
legal.terms.s1.heading: Parties and acceptance
legal.terms.s1.items.1: The Platform is provided by the Cyber ICE Box project team ("we", "us"). The team is an independent group of developers and is not registered as a legal entity.
legal.terms.s1.items.2: The project is supported by the V. V. Popovskyi Department of Infocommunication Engineering of Kharkiv National University of Radio Electronics (KhNURE). The University is not a party to these Terms and does not provide the Platform.
legal.terms.s1.items.3: "User" or "you" means a person who visits the Platform or holds an account on it.
legal.terms.s1.items.4: By creating an account, taking part in an event or otherwise using the Platform, you confirm that you have read and agree to these Terms and the [Privacy Policy](/privacy). If you do not agree, do not use the Platform.
legal.terms.s1.items.5: If you are under 14, you may use the Platform only with the consent of a parent or other legal guardian. The organizer of an event for minors (for example, a school olympiad) is responsible for obtaining such consent.
legal.terms.s2.heading: Accounts
legal.terms.s2.items.1: An account is required to take part in events. You agree to provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
legal.terms.s2.items.2: Each person may hold only one account.
legal.terms.s2.items.3: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all actions taken through your account. Do not share your sign-in credentials with anyone.
legal.terms.s2.items.4: If you suspect unauthorized access to your account, change your password immediately and let us know.
legal.terms.s2.items.5: You may stop using the Platform at any time and request deletion of your account as described in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
legal.terms.s3.heading: Acceptable use
legal.terms.s3.body: The Platform contains intentionally vulnerable systems and permits the use of offensive tools. This is allowed only within the following limits:
legal.terms.s3.items.1: Offensive tools and techniques may be used only against targets in the labs provided to you, and only while your access to them lasts.
legal.terms.s3.items.2: You must not attack, scan, overload or otherwise interfere with the Platform itself (its web applications, APIs, VPN gateways and infrastructure) or with other users' accounts and environments, unless a challenge explicitly requires it.
legal.terms.s3.items.3: You must not use the Platform, VPN access or lab infrastructure for any action against third parties or systems outside the labs, including unauthorized access, sending spam, cryptocurrency mining or hosting malicious content.
legal.terms.s3.items.4: Knowledge and tools gained on the Platform may be applied to real systems only with the written permission of their owners and in accordance with the law.
legal.terms.s3.items.5: You must not circumvent access restrictions, create accounts by automated means or use Platform resources beyond what a challenge requires.
legal.terms.s3.items.6: If you discover a vulnerability in the Platform itself (as opposed to a training target), do not exploit or disclose it; report it as described on the [Report a vulnerability](/security) page. A good-faith report made under those rules is not a breach of these Terms.
legal.terms.s4.heading: Events and organizers' rules
legal.terms.s4.items.1: Events (competitions, training courses, olympiads) are created by organizers: teachers, educational institutions, communities and other persons whom we have enabled to do so.
legal.terms.s4.items.2: The organizer sets the rules of their event: its schedule, team composition, registration, scoring and awards. Event rules are binding on participants and supplement these Terms; in the event of a conflict, these Terms prevail.
legal.terms.s4.items.3: The organizer may request additional information at registration and is responsible for the content and lawfulness of such requests.
legal.terms.s4.items.4: We are not a party to arrangements between an organizer and participants (including those concerning prizes) and are not responsible for their performance.
legal.terms.s5.heading: Scoring and disqualification
legal.terms.s5.items.1: Points are awarded automatically under the event rules. Results may be recalculated in the event of a technical error, a change to a challenge or a detected violation.
legal.terms.s5.items.2: While an event is running, you must not: share or publish flags, solutions or hints; use other people's solutions; collude with other participants or teams; use multiple accounts; or interfere with other participants or with the scoring system.
legal.terms.s5.items.3: In the event of a violation, the organizer or we may cancel points, disqualify a participant or team, or restrict access to the event or to the Platform.
legal.terms.s5.items.4: A disqualification may be appealed: on matters of event rules, to the organizer; on actions taken by the Platform, to us.
legal.terms.s5.items.5: The results of a completed event are kept as part of its history. Data retention periods are set out in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
legal.terms.s6.heading: User content
legal.terms.s6.items.1: User content is anything you submit to the Platform: answers to challenges (including flags), write-ups, registration form answers, profile pictures, team names and the like.
legal.terms.s6.items.2: The rights in your content remain yours. You allow us, free of charge, to store it and show it to organizers and, where the event rules provide, to other participants, only to the extent needed to operate the Platform.
legal.terms.s6.items.3: You warrant that you are entitled to submit your content and that it does not violate the law or the rights of others. You must not post offensive, discriminatory or unlawful content, or upload malicious code, except where a challenge itself requires it within a lab.
legal.terms.s6.items.4: We may remove content that violates these Terms.
legal.terms.s7.heading: Intellectual property
legal.terms.s7.items.1: The Platform's software, design, texts, logo and other materials belong to the project team and to the authors of the respective materials. Where part of the code is distributed under an open-source licence, the terms of that licence apply to it.
legal.terms.s7.items.2: Challenges, lab scenarios and other training materials belong to their authors: team members, organizers or invited authors. Publishing a challenge on the Platform does not transfer exclusive rights in it to us. By publishing a challenge, its author allows it to be used on the Platform, including in the challenge catalogue, according to its access settings. The Platform team may hide or remove any challenge from the catalogue or an event, in particular if it violates these Terms.
legal.terms.s7.items.3: You may use Platform materials only for learning on the Platform. Copying, publishing or distributing challenge descriptions, their files or lab images without the rights holder's permission is prohibited. Write-ups may be published after an event has ended, unless its rules provide otherwise.
legal.terms.s7.items.4: The Cyber ICE Box name and logo may not be used without our consent, except to refer to the Platform.
legal.terms.s8.heading: No warranty
legal.terms.s8.items.1: The Platform is provided free of charge for educational purposes. We make every effort to keep it running reliably, but we cannot guarantee uninterrupted operation, preservation of lab state or fitness for a particular purpose.
legal.terms.s8.items.2: We may change, suspend or discontinue individual features, challenges or labs, including for maintenance.
legal.terms.s8.items.3: Training targets are intentionally vulnerable. Do not place any confidential data of your own on them.
legal.terms.s9.heading: Limitation of liability
legal.terms.s9.items.1: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or loss of data or results arising from the use of, or inability to use, the Platform.
legal.terms.s9.items.2: You are solely responsible for your actions outside the Platform, including any use of the knowledge and tools gained on it.
legal.terms.s10.heading: Suspension and termination
legal.terms.s10.items.1: We may suspend or terminate access to an account if you violate these Terms or event rules, pose a threat to the security of the Platform or other users, or where required by law. Where possible, we will notify you in advance and explain the reason.
legal.terms.s10.items.2: You may stop using the Platform and request deletion of your account at any time.
legal.terms.s10.items.3: Provisions that by their nature should survive termination, including Sections 6–9 and 12, remain in effect after access ends.
legal.terms.s11.heading: Changes to these Terms
legal.terms.s11.items.1: We may amend these Terms. A new version takes effect on the date shown at the top of this page.
legal.terms.s11.items.2: We announce material changes by email to all account holders and on the Platform at least 14 days before they take effect.
legal.terms.s11.items.3: Minor edits (wording or typo fixes that do not change the meaning) only update the "Last updated" date.
legal.terms.s11.items.4: By continuing to use the Platform after the changes take effect, you accept the new version. If you do not agree, stop using the Platform; you may also delete your account.
legal.terms.s12.heading: Governing law and disputes
legal.terms.s12.body: These Terms are governed by the law of Ukraine. If a dispute arises, write to us and we will try to resolve it.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.intro: This Policy explains which cookies the websites of the Cyber ICE Box platform (the "Platform") use and how to manage your choice. It supplements the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
legal.cookies.s1.heading: What cookies are
legal.cookies.s1.body: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser, for example to keep you signed in or remember your settings.
legal.cookies.s2.heading: Categories of cookies
legal.cookies.s2.items.1: Necessary — for sign-in, security and remembering your settings. The Platform cannot work without them, so they are set without separate consent.
legal.cookies.s2.items.2: Analytics — Google Analytics. Set only when you click "Accept all", or turn on "Analytics" in the cookie settings and click "Save choice".
legal.cookies.s2.after: We do not use advertising cookies.
legal.cookies.s3.heading: List of cookies
legal.cookies.s3.rows.1.name: __Host-session
legal.cookies.s3.rows.2.name: oauth_state, oauth_intent, oauth_setup_token, oauth_link_sid, return_to
legal.cookies.s3.rows.2.duration: Up to 10 minutes or until the browser is closed
legal.cookies.s3.rows.3.name: cib_theme
legal.cookies.s3.rows.3.purpose: Your chosen theme: light, dark or system
legal.cookies.s3.rows.4.name: cib_consent
legal.cookies.s3.rows.4.purpose: Your choice under the cookie policy
legal.cookies.s3.rows.5.name: _GRECAPTCHA
legal.cookies.s3.rows.5.purpose: Protects the sign-in, sign-up and password recovery forms against bots (reCAPTCHA)
legal.cookies.s3.rows.6.name: _ga, _ga_<ID>
legal.cookies.s3.after: Platform cookies apply across all of its sites, so your choice is the same everywhere. Some interface settings are kept in your browser and are not shared with anyone.
legal.cookies.s4.heading: Google Analytics
legal.cookies.s4.items.1: Google Analytics runs only with your consent. Until you give it, no analytics cookies are set and Google receives only cookieless signals that are not linked to your browser.
legal.cookies.s4.items.2: If you accept analytics, Google Analytics collects data about the pages you visit, your device and approximate location. Advertising features are always off.
legal.cookies.s4.items.3: Google Analytics data is processed by Google, including in the United States; see the [Privacy Policy](/privacy) for details.
legal.cookies.s5.heading: How to change your choice
legal.cookies.s5.items.1: Click "Cookie settings" in the site footer or account menu, turn "Analytics" on or off and click "Save choice". Your choice applies to all Platform sites.
legal.cookies.s5.items.2: When you withdraw consent, the Google Analytics cookies are deleted from your browser.
legal.cookies.s5.items.3: You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block necessary cookies, signing in to the Platform will not work.
legal.cookies.s6.heading: Changes to this Policy
legal.cookies.s6.body: We update this Policy whenever the list of cookies changes and announce material changes as described in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

legal.security.title: Report a vulnerability
legal.security.intro: We appreciate every report that helps make the Cyber ICE Box platform (the "Platform") more secure. This page describes what is in scope, how to report a vulnerability and what to expect from us.
legal.security.s1.heading: Scope
legal.security.s1.items.1: The Platform itself: the main site, sign-in and account pages, administration, the challenge catalogue, event sites and the API.
legal.security.s1.items.2: Deliberately vulnerable lab targets and challenge files are out of scope: breaking them is the game.
legal.security.s2.heading: How to report
legal.security.s2.items.1: What is affected: the address, page or feature.
legal.security.s2.after: Screenshots or a proof of concept (PoC) are welcome.
legal.security.s3.heading: Rules
legal.security.s3.items.1: Do not run denial-of-service attacks or load tests.
legal.security.s3.items.2: Do not access, change or delete other users' data beyond what is needed to demonstrate the issue.
legal.security.s3.items.3: Do not attack other participants or third-party services.
legal.security.s3.items.5: Give us reasonable time to fix the issue before any disclosure.
legal.security.s4.heading: Our commitment
legal.security.s4.items.1: We will acknowledge your report within 5 working days.
legal.security.s4.items.2: We will keep you updated on our progress.
legal.security.s4.items.3: If you wish, we will credit you for the finding.
legal.security.s4.items.4: Good-faith research within these rules is not treated as a violation of the [Terms of Use](/terms).
legal.security.s5.heading: Rewards
legal.security.s5.body: Cyber ICE Box is a free educational project, so we do not run a bug bounty programme. We are sincerely grateful to everyone who helps make the Platform more secure.
